newsitem.title: FRANCE: Mediterranean states concerned over Mideast.
newsitem.headline: Mediterranean states concerned over Mideast.

text.p: Foreign ministers and officials from 11 Mediterranean countries, attending a cooperation forum in Algiers, said on Saturday they were worried about the Middle East peace process.
"The ministers expressed their deep anxiety in the face of the situation prevailing at the moment in the Middle East," they said in a statement quoted by the official Algerian news agency APS.
The statement was issued at the end of their two-day Mediterranean Forum meeting in the Algerian capital.

The gathering was attended by foreign ministers of Algeria, France, Egypt Italy, Tunisia, while remaining participating countries were represented by secretary of states or senior diplomats. Israel was not present in the forum.
Talks between Israel and Palestinians on expanding Palestinian self-rule have been stalled since the start of a settlement building in March.
